title: Nutty Creamy Vietnamese Salmon Banh Cuon
description: A smoky, nutty salmon dish with a creamy coconut‑peanut sauce, served in a single pot for a quick Vietnamese-inspired meal.
instructions: Heat a medium skillet over medium heat.
Pour coconut milk into the skillet and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the smooth peanut butter and toasted ground peanuts until fully dissolved.
Add the flaked smoked salmon, lime juice, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, ground ginger, and chili flakes to the skillet.
Gently stir the mixture, allowing the salmon to heat through without overcooking, about 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt if needed, though the soy sauce adds saltiness.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce thicken slightly, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the chopped cilantro and roasted cashew nuts.
Transfer the creamy salmon mixture to a Talavera plate for serving.
Garnish with additional cashew nuts if desired.
Serve immediately with steamed rice or as a standalone dish.
Enjoy the nutty, creamy flavor of this Vietnamese-inspired salmon banh cuon.
